name: SKYPASS Visa Secured Card

apr.notes: Variable APR applies; rate not displayed on the product page. Refer to the Cardmember Agreement for current terms.

fx_fee.notes: Foreign transaction fee not displayed on page; confirm current terms in the Cardmember Agreement.

credit_required.notes: Secured card designed for building or rebuilding credit; a refundable security deposit is required.

base_rate.description: Earn SKYPASS miles on eligible purchases; refer to the Cardmember Agreement for the earning rate.

rewards.redemption_notes: Miles accumulate in a Korean Air SKYPASS frequent flyer account and can be redeemed for Korean Air awards. No mileage caps on any SKYPASS Visa card.

benefits.title: Credit building with security deposit
benefits.description: Secured card that requires a refundable security deposit; designed to help build or rebuild credit history with responsible use.

benefits.title: SKYPASS mile earning
benefits.description: Earn Korean Air SKYPASS miles on eligible purchases; miles accumulate to one SKYPASS mileage account.

notes: Co-brand credit card with Korean Air SKYPASS, issued by U.S. Bank. The visaSecuredCard.do product page redirects to the SKYPASS Visa welcome page, so specific fees/APR/earning rates are not displayed; the card is confirmed as an active product via the contact page (grouped with SKYPASS SkyBlue Visa and SKYPASS Classic Visa for servicing). Secured card for credit building requiring a refundable deposit.
